acceptance: C logical streams use C independent database sessions and a versioned schedule with one outstanding query per session.
The measured interval includes all admitted in-flight work and only complete workload cycles can contribute.
The runner records completed work, active duration, per-session fairness, P50/P95/P99 latency, errors, cancellations, and client resource use.
A timed-out or leaked stream cannot be silently counted and cannot overlap a later scored phase without an explicit invalid outcome.
The default mix excludes JOB and full TPC-Havoc while supporting a bounded admitted advanced-function mix.
Official TPC throughput execution and metrics remain behaviorally separate.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. The ADR's numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, and M4 reference are pilot hypotheses until the methodology-freeze item closes.
description: Extend BenchBox's concurrent-stream infrastructure to execute deterministic finite batches across independent database sessions. Preserve one outstanding query per session, full result consumption, complete-cycle accounting, fairness and tail telemetry, and timeout containment.
